provenance.author: AUD-07 slice 1 (Claude)
provenance.notes: AUD-07 C13d corrected rule: the trading day of a decision is the Africa/Cairo date at the decision time, i.e. the candle CLOSE for a candle-close decision; the rollover happens before that decision's halt test. SOL (risk 10 %) is stopped on candle 284 (08:00 UTC, Cairo day D) for -1.06 R = -10.6 % > the 8 % daily halt. XRP signals on candle 287, which opens 20:00 UTC (Cairo day D) and closes 00:00 UTC = Cairo day D+1, so the halt of day D no longer applies: XRP enters at the open of 288. XRP: ATR 2 (wick 1), stop 4; R = ((199.96 - 200.04) - (199.96 + 200.04) x 0.0005) / 4 = -0.0700.
